hotspots.title: Trump administration’s visa and immigration crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has expanded its immigration restrictions by pausing immigrant visa appointments worldwide and introducing sweeping new screening policies. Additionally, proposed six-figure fees for H-1B visas and record-high ICE arrest numbers have amplified systemic debates surrounding the legal immigration framework.
hotspots.affect: Disproportionate focus stems from alarmist reactions to rapid administrative policy shifts and high-stakes economic implications across healthcare and tech sectors.

hotspots.title: Federal judge rejects DOJ attempt to drop Steve Bannon case
hotspots.blurb: A federal judge appointed during the previous Trump term denied the Justice Department's motion to dismiss Steve Bannon's criminal contempt conviction. The ruling cited an insufficient explanation from federal prosecutors, stalling efforts by Trump loyalists to clear the former adviser's legal record.
hotspots.affect: Commands heavy attention due to dramatic institutional tension between a MAGA-aligned DOJ and the judiciary over high-profile partisan legal cases.

hotspots.title: Trump beef import plan triggers rancher and GOP backlash
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's initiative to lower retail meat costs by lifting tariffs and importing 300,000 metric tons of foreign beef has met fierce pushback from domestic livestock organizations. Republican lawmakers from agricultural states have openly urged the administration to reverse course to protect American cattle producers.
hotspots.affect: Drives emotional engagement by creating a rare rift between core agricultural populist bases and the administration's trade strategy.

hotspots.title: Trump administration tightens mail ballot and voter file rules
hotspots.blurb: The US Postal Service has put into effect new administrative restrictions on mail ballot deliveries targeting voter eligibility rules ahead of the midterms. Concurrently, efforts to hire private contractors for federal collection of nationwide voter files have reignited intense debate over election integrity.
hotspots.affect: Generates strong affective investment around fears of voter suppression and state-level electoral manipulation.

hotspots.title: Fremskrittspartiet faces controversy over participation and governance
hotspots.blurb: Norway's Progress Party (FrP) has drawn public criticism over proposals that political rivals argue limit political participation. Meanwhile, the party continues to advance its workforce integration proposals and secure local governance leadership roles in Bærum.
hotspots.affect: Attracts sustained media heat surrounding democratic norms, local electoral shifts, and ideological battles over integration policies.
